description: Defines a SwiftUI View component named StatusPill, which displays network connection status with visual indicators, including state-based colors, activity info, voice wake status, and animation for connecting state.

classes.name: StatusPill
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that visually represents a connection and activity status using colors, icons, and animations.

classes.name: GatewayState
classes.description: An enum representing the various connection states: connected, connecting, error, disconnected.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A struct representing an activity with a title, system image, and optional tint color.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main view layout that composes the UI based on current state and properties.

methods.name: updatePulse
methods.description: Handles animation state for the pulse effect when the gateway is connecting.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides a dynamic accessibility label summarizing the current status and activity.
